issues.note: Already fixed by open PR https://github.com/decentraland/unity-explorer/pull/10668 (bugsweep W46, commit 409b0060f for #10643, which has the same Sentry stack, RenderGroundSystem.GetTerrainBounds:199 <- OnTerrainLoaded:220 <- LoadLandscapeStartupOperation:24): root cause confirmed independently. Landscape.LoadTerrainAsync raises TerrainLoaded even when TerrainGenerator.GenerateGenesisTerrainAndShowAsync returned early (WorldManifest.Empty from a failed manifest fetch or the Custom env) or WorldTerrainGenerator.GenerateTerrain skipped zero parcels, so TerrainModel stays null. That PR stops publishing the event in those cases, so it should also close #10669 and #8019. Link those issues to it instead of making a second change.

Both views already read the same field from the same endpoint: Lobby rails (LobbyDocumentController.cs:449-450 -> GetHighlightedDestinationsAsync / GetRecentlyVisitedDestinationsAsync with withConnectedUsers:true, count at :845 = connected_addresses?.Length ?? user_count) and the Places modal (PlacesResultsController.cs:304-347 -> SearchDestinationsAsync / GetRecentlyVisitedDestinationsAsync with withConnectedUsers:true, PlaceCardView.cs:159 and PlaceDetailPanelView.cs:200 use the identical connected_addresses?.Length ?? user_count) hit /destinations (GET list or POST by ids), both lists are refetched on every show with no client cache, and in decentraland/places both getDestinationsList.ts and getDestinationsListById.ts compute counts via the same getHotScenes + fetchConnectedUsersForDestinations path, so a 5 vs 14 gap is the backend returning different live counts between the two reque

Re-verified on origin/dev 04c7a938b: the UUAV Rust source is in-repo (Explorer/Assets/Plugins/UUAV/native), and select_streams in native/src/playback/unit.rs:90 takes find_best_stream(VIDEO) without excluding AV_DISPOSITION_ATTACHED_PIC, so an mp3's mjpeg cover art becomes the video track and the hardware-only macOS decoder rejects it; but there is no C# workaround (uuav_player_open_media_async takes only a URL, no audio-only/disable-video option exists in NativeMethods.cs or the IPC protocol), and any native edit changes the source digest that uuav-verify.yml checks against scripts/uuav/uuav-binaries.lock.json, so the fix needs a uuav-native.yml rebuild of both platforms plus a human relock, which a sweep commit cannot produce.
